So I thought I'd share the photos taken with my camera from GenCon 2013. I had a blast meeting everyone and taking some group and posed shots with everyone. All of my photos are free to use, just don't sell 'em! (CC-BY-NC)

http://www.flickr.com/photos/cajunjoel/tags/cosplay/

https://picasaweb.google.com/kuthixo/GenCon201302

Enjoy! 

--Joel

P.S. I dressed as Legacy.

posts.name: Nielzabub
posts.cooked: I think it's a bit of fantasy fulfillment. Part of the reason we read comic books and watch movies is to escape our everyday lives and immerse ourselves in a world that is different from the one we live in. Cosplaying is just another process of immersion. You can feel a little bit like the person you're imitating and just be awesome for a little while.

posts.name: Rabit
posts.cooked:
Personally, I don't cosplay. I really suck at playing up the character.  Acting and improv are NOT things I do well…

I just wanted to help advertise SotM, so I picked a costume I thought I might be able to pull off. Being hairless, it was going to be Ra, AZ (which, as I tend to be pretty picky, was going to be hard to pull off), Bunker (even harder than AZ), or a male version of visionary (from an alternate timeline, of course  ).

So Ra it was! (I actually have cards to give people with info on the character and the game if they ask who I am dressed as.)

I do want to eventually do an AZ costume (because I love AZ), but it's going to take more time and money than I currently have available.
